description: This file defines a service for generating trash talk comments in a Tic Tac Toe game, utilizing OpenAI's API with various tone and event presets, including fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: hashTrashTalkContext
methods.description: Creates a stable hash string representing the game state and context for caching purposes.

methods.name: generateTrashTalk
methods.description: Generates a short, PG-rated trash talk comment based on game context, using OpenAI API or fallback if unavailable.
